project.name: QH :: Module :: Product Builder
project.description: The Product Builder domain (47 tables, one bounded context, one PRODUCTBUILDER schema/database - see README's "Domain vs Schema" section): Core (PRODUCT, PRODUCT_VERSION, ...), Common Rules (Eligibility, Channel, Pricing, ...), Deposit, Loan and Reference data all live together here under ir.bank.qh.productbuilder.{core,commonrules,deposit,loan,reference}. They used to be five separate Maven modules; merged into one because they always deploy and version together.
